positions.title: Co-Creator, Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Waypost is an open-source, self-hosted feature flag management system that specializes in A/B Testing, providing analytical insights for experiments. Built with React, Node, Express, and PostgreSQL.

- Created Waypost, an open-source, self-hosted A/B testing and feature flagging platform (with React, Node, PostgreSQL)
- Wrote 2 data pipelines that aggregate and analyze experiment data, run statistical tests, and save results in database
- Built JavaScript SDKs (React and Node) that receive data via SSE and determine feature version and experiment status
- Developed API endpoints and built React/Redux app to enable management of feature flags, A/B tests, and metrics
- Wrote unit tests and integration tests using Jest and Mock Service Workers for the React app and Redux reducers
- Load tested varying number of connections to the feature flag provider service to understand load it could handle
- Managed the design and CSS, creating user-friendly interfaces and visualizations of experiments’ statistical data
- Designed ERDs to handle storage of data for feature flags, metrics, experiments, and statistical results
- Made architectural decisions, authored documentation, and co-wrote technical case study

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Marketplace Seller Fulfillment & Payouts team
- Managed 20+ complex experiments for critical features on Marketplace that increased transaction volume, collaborating with software engineers to diagnose ambiguous experiment results
- Analyzed abusive buyer behavior, influencing the team to develop a returns feature that saved millions in costs
- Sized user issues and impact of new features by classifying seller support tickets into topics

positions.title: Senior Analyst, Business Operations and Strategy
positions.description:
- Analyzed large-scale data using SQL (Amazon Redshift), Python, and Spark to extract business insights and help Product Managers make strategic decisions
- Optimized dashboard performance by building reverse ETL data pipelines with Python that cleaned and aggregated large datasets
- Analyzed A/B tests and provided recommendations for feature roll-out strategy
- Built linear regression models to predict number of website-driven calls not being tracked
- Created 15+ Tableau dashboards to inform executives and PM’s of trends and impact of new features

positions.title: Supply Chain Analyst II
positions.description:
(Originally at Jet.com acquired by Walmart eCommerce)
Forecasted weekly inventory levels and determined orders needed by item and location for monthly budget through careful data analysis, growing in-stock rate by 20% and increasing forecast accuracy for Outdoor business
